mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions(from_wallet_id, to_wallet_id, amount, tx_type, status) VALUES(#{fromWalletId}, #{toWalletId}, #{amount}, #{txType}, #{status})
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN wallets fw ON t.from_wallet_id = fw.id LEFT JOIN users fu ON fw.user_id = fu.id LEFT JOIN wallets tw ON t.to_wallet_id = tw.id LEFT JOIN users tu ON tw.user_id = tu.id
(fu.username ILIKE '%' || #{username} || '%' OR tu.username ILIKE '%' || #{username} || '%')
AND t.created_at >= #{fromDate}
AND t.created_at < #{toDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day'

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COUNT(*)::bigint AS count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM transactions WHERE created_at >= #{fromDate} AND created_at < #{toDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date
